articles.headline: A-League Men Stocks: Has Talay fixed the Wanderers?
articles.description: Talay's Wanderers dazzled, Melbourne's heavyweights misfired and an unexpected contender is already shaking up the A-League table.

images.name: Miguel Di Pizio [1296x729]
images.caption: Miguel Di Pizio, 22, was in fine form as the Wanderers romped to a 5-2 win over Auckland on Saturday.

images.name: Franco Lino and Nathaniel Atkinson [1296x729]
images.caption: Has the A-Leagues' plan to open the season with a bunch of derbies yielded the results they wanted?

articles.headline: A-League Men Stocks Round 1: I've got chulls
articles.description: Each week, ESPN's experts will take you through the weekend's action across the A-League Men and the A-League Women to give you the lowdown on whose stocks are up, whose stocks are down, and what has the people talking coming out of the weekend.

images.name: Stocks [1296x729]
images.caption: Whose stocks are up and down after the opening round of the new A-League Mens' season?

images.name: Aspropotamitis' late winner gives Macarthur victory over Perth
images.caption: Macarthur's Jonathan Aspropotamitis snatches victory from Perth Glory with a thumping header off Ryan Fraser's brilliant free kick.

articles.headline: 777 exec Wander, who led Everton bid, guilty of fraud; to repay $500M
articles.description: An American businessman whose firm invested in several European soccer clubs that struggled under its ownership pleaded guilty to fraud Thursday in New York.

images.name: Josh Wander 777 case [1296x729]
images.caption: 777 Partners founder exits federal court on Thursday after pleading guilty to a multi-million dollar fraud scheme.
images.alt: 777 Partners founder exits federal court on Thursday after pleading guilty to a multi-million dollar fraud scheme.

articles.headline: For the A-League, a new season brings an old challenge: How do you make people care?
articles.description: The start of the 2026-27 A-League Men and A-League Women seasons is upon us and, while there will be fresh stars and storylines, the biggest challenge will be rebuilding buzz, connection and belief.

images.name: South Melbourne stun Victory to claim historic Australia Cup
images.caption: South Melbourne defeat Melbourne Victory 4-3 on penalties (1-1 aet) to become the first non-A-League club to win the Australia Cup.

articles.headline: The Australian Championship is back -- and ready for its crucial second act
articles.description: Year one proved the concept. Now the Australian Championship faces the bigger challenge: showing it can grow into something built to last.
